title: GPT-4b micro: Yamanaka factor variants with over 50-fold higher expression
summary: OpenAI and Retro Biosciences used a specialized model to design Yamanaka factor variants that produced over 50-fold higher expression of reprogramming markers in vitro than controls, with results replicated across multiple donors, cell types, and delivery methods, and pluripotency confirmed. Reported by OpenAI; the model is not publicly available.

evidence.tested: Designed Yamanaka factor variants were tested in vitro across multiple donors, cell types and delivery methods, with over 50-fold higher expression of reprogramming markers and pluripotency confirmed relative to controls.
evidence.unknown: The page gives no detailed protocol or data, the model is not publicly available, and the results are reported by OpenAI only.
evidence.ai_role: A specialized GPT-4b micro model designed Yamanaka factor variants.
